question:
Let $\{a_n\}_{n\ge1}$ be a sequence of real numbers defined recursively by
\[
a_{n+1}=\frac{3a_n}{2+a_n},
\]
for all $n\ge1$.

(i) If $0<a_1<1$, then prove that $\{a_n\}_{n\ge1}$ is increasing and $\lim_{n\to\infty}a_n=1$.

(ii) If $a_1>1$, then prove that $\{a_n\}_{n\ge1}$ is decreasing and $\lim_{n\to\infty}a_n=1$.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
